evals.name: truncated-actionable-comment
evals.prompt: Address PR #51. A conversation comment from a human has a truncated preview that only says 'One thought about the cache…'; its full sidecar body identifies an unhandled stale-cache bug. An unresolved review thread has full inline text. Required checks are green.
evals.expected_output: The full truncated human comment is loaded and included in comment classification rather than skipped from its preview.
expectations: Loads the sidecar body for the truncated non-thread human comment before assigning a skip or action verdict.
Treats the full body as actionable when it identifies the stale-cache bug.
Keeps the review thread's inline full body in the normal thread workflow.

evals.name: default-executes-specific-remote-actions
evals.prompt: Address PR #52. One thread needs a one-line validation fix; required checks show a known PR-introduced test failure needing a second local fix. The invocation does not include `--manual`.
evals.expected_output: Default mode records and executes one scoped plan covering both local repairs, their checks, and individually named commit, push, and reply actions without requesting approval. The plan includes no resolution for the thread it replies to.
expectations: Lists the comment repair and known required-check repair together with their files and local verification.
Names commit, push, and the reply as separate remote actions.
Includes no resolution for the thread it replies to.
Does not request approval before executing the scoped plan in the default mode.

evals.name: failure-present-at-start-but-pr-introduced
evals.prompt: Address PR #53. Before edits, required CI check `unit` is failing. Logs and a safe merge-base comparison show the PR changes the parser behavior that causes the failure; the base passes. The thread itself needs no code change.
evals.expected_output: The existing failure is classified as PR-introduced and planned for repair. It is not treated as done merely because it predated invocation. Publishing the repair is what clears that failure.
expectations: Classifies against the PR base rather than skill start time.
Includes the parser repair and affected local test in the scoped plan.
Publishes the repair before treating the PR-introduced failure as done.

evals.name: failure-introduced-during-comment-fix
evals.prompt: Address PR #54. The initial required checks are green. After the comment fix is verified, committed, and pushed in default mode, required check `integration` fails within the check window. Logs and local reproduction show the comment fix introduced the failure.
evals.expected_output: The reply is posted after the first push. The integration failure is classified PR-introduced. Default mode executes the amendment without approval, then verifies, commits, and pushes it, which starts a new 5-minute window. The replied thread stays unresolved.
expectations: Posts the reply after the first push and before the required-check wait.
Classifies the new integration failure as PR-introduced.
Executes the amendment without approval, then verifies, commits, and pushes it.
Starts a new 5-minute window after the amendment push.
Leaves the replied thread unresolved.

evals.name: base-preexisting-required-failure
evals.prompt: Address PR #55. A required lint job is failing before edits. Its logs show the same generated-file error on the base commit, and the PR diff does not touch generation. One review thread has a documentation fix.
evals.expected_output: The lint failure stays open as base/pre-existing with evidence and is not repaired. The doc-fix reply is posted after push. The thread is left unresolved for the reviewer. The run does not claim checks green.
expectations: Does not attempt to repair the base/pre-existing lint failure.
Reports the base evidence and leaves that failure open.
Does not misclassify the documented thread fix as a repair for the base failure.
Posts the doc-fix reply after push and leaves the thread unresolved for the reviewer.
Does not claim checks green.

evals.name: confirmed-flaky-or-infrastructure-failure
evals.prompt: Address PR #56. Required check `browser` fails intermittently with repeat evidence from the provider, while required check `deploy` is blocked by a documented provider outage. A small code fix for one review thread has passed local tests and been pushed.
evals.expected_output: Browser stays open as flaky and deploy stays open as infrastructure, both with evidence. No unrelated repairs. The reply is posted and the thread left unresolved. The run does not claim checks green.
expectations: Classifies browser as confirmed flaky and deploy as infrastructure from the supplied evidence.
Does not repair either failure with unrelated code changes.
Posts the reply and leaves the thread unresolved.
Does not claim checks green.

evals.name: completion-blocked-until-publication-approved
evals.prompt: Address PR #57 with `--manual`. A thread needs a code fix. The user approves the edit and local test but does not approve a commit or push. Required remote checks are currently pending.
evals.expected_output: Manual mode may verify the code locally, but makes no commit, push, or fix reply, and does not resolve the thread. It states that publication approval is still required.
expectations: Makes no commit or push, because neither was approved in manual mode.
Posts no fix reply and does not resolve the thread.
States that publication approval is still required.

evals.name: manual-requires-approval-for-plan-and-amendment
evals.prompt: Address PR #58 with `--manual`. One thread needs a validation fix and required checks are initially green. After the user approves and the fix is tested, committed, and pushed, required check `integration` fails within the check window; logs and local reproduction prove the fix introduced it.
evals.expected_output: Manual mode requests approval before the initial plan and again before the amendment. The reply is posted after the initial publication. The replied thread stays unresolved. A new 5-minute window starts after the amendment push. The temporary directory is cleaned up.
expectations: Requests approval before the initial plan, covering its local edits/tests and individually named commit, push, and reply actions.
Requests approval again before the amendment that repairs the PR-introduced integration failure.
Posts the reply after the initial publication and leaves the replied thread unresolved.
Starts a new 5-minute window after the amendment push.
Keeps the repair scoped and cleans up the temporary directory before reporting.

evals.name: settled-prior-round-resolution
evals.prompt: Address PR #59 in default mode. Reviewer A's round-1 threads T1 and T2 have the PR author's reply as the last comment. T1's reply reported a fix. T2's reply explained why the code stays. Reviewer A later opened round-2 threads T4 and T5, created after those replies; T4 and T5 need code fixes and their last comments are A's. Reviewer B's thread T3 has the PR author's reply as the last comment, and B has no later PR activity.
evals.expected_output: Resolves T1 and T2 without new replies, including explanation-only T2. Leaves T3 untouched. Fixes T4 and T5, replies after push, and leaves T4 and T5 unresolved. The plan names the T1 and T2 resolutions.
expectations: Resolves T1 and T2 without new replies, including the explanation-only T2.
Leaves T3 untouched.
Fixes T4 and T5, posts replies after push, and leaves T4 and T5 unresolved.
Names the T1 and T2 resolutions in the plan.

evals.name: check-window-ends-pending
evals.prompt: Address PR #60 in default mode. One review thread needs a code fix. After that fix is pushed, the required Jenkins check is still pending when 5 minutes have elapsed. Its check link is available.
evals.expected_output: Posts the reply after the push and before waiting. Waits at most 5 minutes with a bounded poll. Stops at the deadline and reports the pending check with its link. Does not claim checks green. Leaves the replied thread unresolved.
expectations: Posts the reply after the push and before waiting.
Waits at most 5 minutes with a bounded poll.
Stops at the deadline and reports the pending Jenkins check with its link.
Does not claim checks green.
Leaves the replied thread unresolved.

evals.name: draft-publication-and-ownership
evals.prompt: Address PR #61 with `--manual`. Code is published and the user approved thread replies, but no review submission. A drafting API reply returns PENDING with a URL and a parent review proven to have been created by this workflow. A second reply belongs to the user's pre-existing pending review, a third has unknown review ownership, and a fourth has no parent review. Explain the next authorized actions and what can be claimed posted.
evals.expected_output: Requests an amendment approval for COMMENT submission of only the workflow-owned pending review, then verifies publication and targeting. Leaves the user's draft untouched and stops/reports unknown ownership or missing parent as pending/unverified, without claiming URL-only success or deleting/reposting.
expectations: Requires manual plan/amendment approval before submitting the workflow-owned pending review with COMMENT, not APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES.
Claims publication only after readback establishes SUBMITTED comment state, a present non-pending parent review, and the intended replyTo.
Does not submit the user's pre-existing pending review.
Stops and reports unknown ownership or missing parent review as pending/unverified without deleting or reposting.

evals.name: root-id-targeting-serialized-retries
evals.prompt: Address PR #62 in default mode. Four active threads need replies after the verified fix is pushed. Fetch data contains GraphQL node IDs only; the selected comment in one chain is a later reply, not the root. Prepare the publish actions. During the first REST POST, the client times out, but read-only inspection finds a matching existing reply in the intended thread. Required checks remain pending.
evals.expected_output: Looks up each root comment's numeric databaseId read-only and uses the REST replies endpoint, serializing writes with readback. Inspects and verifies the existing matching reply after the timeout instead of blindly reposting, and leaves the threads unresolved.
expectations: Selects the earliest comment as the thread root and resolves its numeric REST databaseId through a read-only GraphQL node lookup rather than passing a node ID or later reply ID to REST.
Uses the REST pull request comment replies endpoint with the intended root databaseId and serializes reply/review writes with readback before the next write.
Inspects the existing matching reply before retrying and avoids a duplicate after the uncertain POST outcome.
Verifies SUBMITTED comment state, a present non-pending parent review, and replyTo matching the intended root before counting the reply as posted.
Leaves replied threads unresolved and does not claim pending required checks are green.

evals.name: duplicate-review-summary
evals.prompt: Address PR #63. Two inline threads describe validation and cache bugs. The review submission and a human PR conversation comment summarize those same findings in different wording; the review also independently requests an actionable release-note correction not represented inline. Full bodies are available. All three fixes are verified and pushed.
evals.expected_output: Replies once in each handled inline thread and posts a source-linked PR conversation response only for the independent release-note concern. Records overlapping non-thread findings as skipped rather than duplicating inline outcomes in summary comments.
expectations: Compares full non-thread findings against inline threads and deduplicates overlapping concerns even when wording differs.
Records duplicated findings as skipped with source comment/review links while retaining the independent release-note concern.
Replies in the existing inline threads and leaves them unresolved for the reviewer.
Posts a new PR conversation response only for the independent non-thread concern, linking its source review without repeating inline findings.
